declare "pabd_filter" {

    argument "logfilename" {}
    argument "log_receiver" {}

    loki.source.file "pabd" {
        targets               = [{__path__ = argument.logfilename.value, "job" = "pabd"}]
        forward_to            = [loki.process.pabd.receiver]
        tail_from_end         = true
    }

    loki.process "pabd" {
        forward_to = [loki.relabel.pabd_drop_label.receiver]


        stage.regex {
            expression = "^(?P<year>\\d{4})(?P<month>\\d{2})(?P<day>\\d{2})\\s(?P<hour>\\d{2})(?P<min>\\d{2})(?P<sec>\\d{2})(?P<ms>\\d{3})\\+(?P<timezone>\\d{2}).{2}.(?P<hostname>[A-Za-z0-9-]+[-A-Za-z0-9]).{1}(?P<service>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<minor_pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<thread_id>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<sev>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<event>[A-Za-z0-9]+).id=(?P<id>[^:]+).(?P<requestType>[^:]+).{1}method=(?<method>[^:]+).{1}realm=(?<realm>[^:]+).address=(?P<address>[^:]+)$"
        }

        stage.regex {
            expression = "^(?P<year>\\d{4})(?P<month>\\d{2})(?P<day>\\d{2})\\s(?P<hour>\\d{2})(?P<min>\\d{2})(?P<sec>\\d{2})(?P<ms>\\d{3})\\+(?P<timezone>\\d{2}).{2}.(?P<hostname>[A-Za-z0-9-]+[-A-Za-z0-9]).{1}(?P<service>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<minor_pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<thread_id>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<sev>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<event>[A-Za-z0-9]+).id=(?P<id>[^:]+).user=(?P<user>[^:]+).domain=(?P<domain>[^:]+).cosId=(?<codId>[^:]+).auth=(?P<auth>[^:]*).type=(?P<type>[^:]+).path=(?P<path>[^:]+).user-agent=(?<useragent>[^:]+).resp_time=(?P<resp_time>[^:]+).resp_size=(?P<resp_size>[^:]+).error=(?P<error>[^:]+).code=(?P<code>[^:]+).status=(?P<status>[^:]+)$"
        }

        // HTTP CARDDAV REQUEST PROXY
        stage.regex {
            expression = "^(?P<year>\\d{4})(?P<month>\\d{2})(?P<day>\\d{2})\\s(?P<hour>\\d{2})(?P<min>\\d{2})(?P<sec>\\d{2})(?P<ms>\\d{3})\\+(?P<timezone>\\d{2}).{2}.(?P<hostname>[A-Za-z0-9-]+[-A-Za-z0-9]).{1}(?P<service>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<minor_pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<thread_id>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<sev>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<event>[A-Za-z0-9]+).id=(?P<id>[^:]+).(?P<requestType>[^:]+).user=(?P<user>[^:]+).domain=(?P<domain>[^:]+).path=(?P<path>[^:]+).((?:depth=(?P<depth>[^:]+))?).client_address=(?P<client_address>[^:]+).user-agent=(?<useragent>[^:]+).code=(?P<code>[^:]+)$"
        }

        stage.labels {
            values = {
                event = null,
            }
        }

        stage.match {
           selector = "{event!~\"CARDDAV\"}"
           action = "drop"
           drop_counter_reason = "non_essential_log"
        }

        // Get date in format
        stage.template {
            source = "formatted_date"
            template = "{{.year}}-{{.month}}-{{.day}}T{{.hour}}:{{.min}}:{{.sec}}.{{.ms}}+{{.timezone}}:00"
        }
        stage.timestamp {
            source = "formatted_date"
            format = "2006-01-02T15:04:05.000Z07:00"
            action_on_failure = "skip"
        }


        stage.template {
            source = "output"
            template = "{\"hostname\":\"{{ .hostname }}\"" +
                        ",\"sev\":\"{{ .sev }}\"" +
                        ",\"thread_id\":\"{{ .thread_id }}\"" +
                        ",\"event\":\"{{ .event }}\"" +
                        ",\"id\":\"{{ .id }}\"" +
                        "{{ if .requestType }},\"requestType\":\"{{ .requestType }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .method }},\"method\":\"{{ .method }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .realm }},\"realm\":\"{{ .realm }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .address }},\"address\":\"{{ .address }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .user }},\"user\":\"{{ .user }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .domain }},\"domain\":\"{{ .domain }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .depth }},\"depth\":{{ .depth }}{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .cosId }},\"cosId\":\"{{ .cosId }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .auth }},\"auth\":\"{{ .auth }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .type }},\"type\":\"{{ .type }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .path }},\"path\":\"{{ .path }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .client_address }},\"client_address\":\"{{ .client_address }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .useragent }},\"user-agent\":\"{{ .useragent }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .resp_time }},\"resp_time\":{{ .resp_time }}{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .resp_size }},\"resp_size\":{{ .resp_size }}{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .error }},\"error\":{{ .error }}{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .code }},\"code\":\"{{ .code }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .status }},\"status\":\"{{ .status }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "}"
        }


        stage.replace {
            source     = "output"
            expression = "(\\\\)"
            replace    = "\\\\\\\\"
        }

        // email bucket
        stage.template {
           source = "email_bucket"
           template = `
               {{- $user := ToLower (TrimSpace (Replace (Replace .user "\"" "" -1) "'" "" -1)) -}}
               {{- $domain := ToLower (TrimSpace (Replace (Replace .domain "\"" "" -1) "'" "" -1)) -}}

               {{- if and $user $domain (or (eq $domain "btinternet.com") (eq $domain "talk21.com") (eq $domain "btopenworld.com")) -}}
                   {{- $email := printf "%s@%s" $user $domain -}}
                   {{ printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $email "") }}
                   {{- end -}}
               `
        }
        stage.labels {
           values = {
              email_bucket = "email_bucket",
           }
        }

        stage.output {
            source = "output"
        }
    }
    loki.relabel "pabd_drop_label" {
       rule {
           action = "labeldrop"
           regex  = "filename|fromhost|cmd|detected_level|service_name"
       }
       forward_to = argument.log_receiver.value
    }
}
